name: Meeting Status Reason
definition: Specifies the underlying reason for a status of a meeting or related instructions.

MeetingCancellationReason.name: Meeting Cancellation Reason
MeetingCancellationReason.definition: Specifies the reason for cancelling a meeting.

InstructionRejectionReason.name: Instruction Rejection Reason
InstructionRejectionReason.definition: Reason of the rejection of the instruction or of the cancellation request.

MeetingStatus.name: Meeting Status
MeetingStatus.definition: Status for which a reason is provided. It is derived from the association between StatusReason and Status.
